## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design a practical, production-grade NLP system that balances latency, multilingual support, retrieval-augmented generation, data privacy, and governance. It also probes how to handle model drift, safety incidents, and rollback mechanisms in a live product environment.

## Key Concepts
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
- Multilingual encoding and code-switch handling (EN/ES/FR)
- ANN indexing (FAISS, HNSW) and document reranking
- Guardrails to prevent hallucinations
- Rollout and rollback strategies with monitoring

## Evaluation Criteria
Strong candidates will demonstrate:
- Clear understanding of the RAG architecture and its components
- Practical knowledge of multilingual NLP models and their trade-offs
- Experience with latency optimization in production systems
- Thoughtful approach to safety, guardrails, and rollback strategies
- Ability to articulate monitoring strategy and quality improvement loops

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

function redactPII(text) {
  const email = /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b/g;
  const phone = /\b(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s+]?)?(\(?\d{2,4}\)?[-.\s+]?\d{3,4}[-.\s+]?\d{3,4})\b/g;
  return text
    .replace(email, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(phone, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

# DP-encoder noise addition (illustrative)
import numpy as np

def dp_encode(vec, epsilon, delta=1e-5):
    sigma = np.sqrt(2 * np.log(1.25/delta)) / epsilon
    noise = np.random.normal(0, sigma, size=vec.shape)
    return vec + noise
```
